name: landonorris-rebuild-deploypages
description: Cloudflare Pages deployment of the landonorris.com study rebuild: build.mjs turns ../src/dist into ./site (Pages-specific layout + _headers), wrangler uploads it.

scripts.project:create: wrangler pages project create landonorris-rebuild --production-branch main
scripts.deploy: wrangler pages deploy site --project-name landonorris-rebuild --branch main --commit-dirty=true
